static_causal_trace.fact: The inherited discovery path emits candidates with discovery_source=APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN and binding_kind=apt, plus zero-cost/zero-secret/zero-friction and pinned package metadata.
auto_capability_acquisition._discovery_supplier_order reads binding_kind before discovery_source and maps apt to apt_cli; the top-level router is not the failure.
auto_apt_cli_acquisition._merge_role_conditioned_apt calls capability_discovery.search_apt_packages and preserves returned discovery_source.

auto_apt_cli_acquisition._viable_candidates unconditionally drops every candidate whose discovery_source is not APT_CATALOG, so the inherited winner cannot reach apt_cli_probe or cli_contract_inference.
apt_cli_probe, cli_contract_inference, pending-binding verification, promotion, and same-invocation replan already exist and must be reused before inventing replacements.

focused_probe.purpose: Verify only that a provenance-valid APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN candidate can cross candidate admission while legacy APT behavior remains accepted and malformed/untrusted APT candidates remain rejected.

repair_scope.minimum_change: Replace the obsolete discovery-source-name coupling with the existing stable APT binding contract at candidate admission while retaining zero-cost, zero-secret, zero-friction, pinned version/hash and all downstream verification gates.
repair_scope.reason: The source-name rejection is the first unconditional failure. Downstream hypotheses are not causally observable until it is removed.
